verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships an official MCP server (and a Slack-based 'Rudder AI' agent) that lets users debug delivery errors, monitor pipelines, write/test transformations, and review audit logs 'all through natural language,' compatible with Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc. A runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint is live and enforces OAuth as documented, corroborating the docs claims beyond marketing copy. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports evaluating the natural-language experience itself (only vendor docs and a connectivity probe, no third-party usage account).
